title: On-cube visual pass for overnight batch (tv-static, wander, cloud v2, etc.)
description: Overnight batch (branch firmware-ux-batches) shipped sight-unseen except for native-harness smoke tests. Eyeball on hardware: tv-static glitch look + gray static background, wander pacing/turn feel, storm-cloud v2 legibility + lightning, bar-eq center origin, text-3d stack dot/dim gaps, rain beatSpawn burst size, fireworks burstOn=beat (rockets flying by unpopped), snake throbDepth/maxLen/autoLevelGain, audio-ripple levelSpeedGain. Also verify BPM lock on real music via /api/audio (bpm field) — the tempo tracker is untested against a real beat detector.

title: Preset sidebar + playlist cycling with per-preset dwell (firmware)
description:
Pop-out sidebar in web_ui.h listing saved presets; playlist cycling.

- Slide-out sidebar with the saved-preset list; click to activate one.
- Default behavior: auto-cycle through the playlist.
- Per-preset dwell time (seconds between) shown + editable in the sidebar, playlist-style.
- Global play/pause of the cycle. One playlist for now (multiple playlists = future).
Depends on preset format + CRUD.
close_reason: Implemented in commit; firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Preset format + save / load / delete (firmware)
description:
Define the canonical serialized form of a preset and the storage/CRUD around it.

- One format: { name, patternId, params:{...}, meta:{ priority?, dwellSec?, created? } }. Pick JSON (human-editable, matches import/export goal).
- Persist to flash (LittleFS/NVS) as one file per preset or one bundle; survive reboot.
- API + UI: save current pattern+params as a named preset; load a preset (apply pattern + params); delete.
- Reuse existing param plumbing (/api/params, /api/param). Foundation for playlist, shuffle, import/export.
close_reason: Implemented in commit (LittleFS + ArduinoJson v7); firmware + native builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Preset / playlist system (firmware)
description:
Umbrella for a firmware-native preset + playlist system. Expands/supersedes cube-utv (Persisted presets / snapshots).

Vision (from user 2026-07-20):
- A defined on-disk format for a saved preset (patternId + all param values + name + metadata). One canonical serialization.
- A pop-out SIDEBAR listing saved presets; by default the cube CYCLES through them like a playlist.
- Per-preset dwell time shown in the sidebar (playlist-style 'time between').
- One big playlist for now; multiple/switchable playlists is a future extension.
- Shuffle mode.
- Priority ranking 1-5: higher-ranked presets appear more often in shuffle; 0 = kept/saved but excluded from shuffle rotation.
- Import / export (download a preset file, edit externally, re-import to OVERWRITE existing) + naming + deletion.
- Future: AI-assisted naming (default path is: download, let AI edit the file separately, re-import).

Children track the concrete slices.
close_reason: All children (format/CRUD, sidebar/playlist, shuffle/priority, import/export) implemented and committed. Epic complete pending on-device flash+verify.

title: Add audio capture (browser) + level/bands over WS
description: Capture from getUserMedia, run AnalyserNode FFT in the browser, send rolling level + N frequency bands to server over WS at high rate. Server merges into PatternContext.audio (and a new audio.bands array). Wire to wavySheet so it actually spikes on input.

title: Calibrate physical wiring layout
description: Use 'Index Walk' pattern at slow speed to determine: which corner is LED 0, which axis the strings run along, and whether each row is serpentine. Save the discovered Layout settings as the default in src/shared/types.ts.

title: Custom user-defined palettes (shared across patterns)
description: Now that tv-static (and everything else) takes standard palettes, add owner-defined palettes: stored on LittleFS beside presets, editable from the console (few color stops -> gradient), appearing in every pattern's palette dropdown alongside the built-ins. Presets referencing a custom palette should export/import it (or degrade gracefully). Motivated by: the old tv-static spectrum coloring was bespoke per-pattern; palettes should be a shared vocabulary.

title: Snake direction calibration: edge-tap gamepad mapping
description:
Snake controls need a direction-calibration step because the user's facing changes which way is left/right/forward/back (Z up/down is invariant, but the horizontal axes depend on which side of the cube they stand at). Applies to BOTH the web gamepad and a physical roaming controller (its orientation drifts as it moves around the cube).

Calibration UX:
- Light up a SINGLE edge of the cube in a distinct color, and draw an ARROW through the middle layers pointing toward that lit edge (so it reads across the volume).
- User taps which control they think points that way (up / down / left / right).
- Repeat for each horizontal direction to build the mapping from control input -> cube-relative direction.
- Store the resulting orientation mapping and apply it to Snake's movement.

Relates to orientation.ts concepts (24-orientation group) and the Snake pattern (pat_snake3d.cpp / cube_snake.h). Physical controller (ESP-NOW remote, cube-qu8) will reuse this since it can roam. Design-heavier — not an easy-win batch item.
close_reason: First pass implemented; native+firmware builds green. On-device tuning needed: (1) arrow readability from angles / colors / brightness are guesses; (2) lit whole target FACE outline + arrow rather than one literal edge — change if you want a single edge; (3) no bijection check (player could tap same button twice); (4) snake-cal appears in pattern dropdown; (5) reboot mid-calibration boots into cal visual. Reopen/ask to adjust any.

title: Custom shifting parameters: per-param LFO / modulation (advanced)
description:
Let any numeric param drift automatically over time.

Per-param modulation config: min, max, rate of change, amount-per-tick (step size), and MODE — ping-pong scrub between min/max vs random walk (tick up/down). Runs on the pattern loop, updating the param each tick.

UI: hidden by default behind an 'advanced' toggle that reveals the modulation controls per param. e.g. draw-speed drifting 5<->50 slowly.
close_reason: Implemented (cube_mod.h; pingpong+walk; NVS+preset persistence; advanced UI). Firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Public / guest 'tinker' mode (AP)
description:
A guest mode for when someone connects to the cube's AP.

- No pattern lock: guest can freely tinker with params.
- Friendly banner: 'feel free to tinker, and reset when you're done'.
- Cheeky reset affordance: 'alright, have you broken it enough? just set it back' -> restores the ADMIN saved settings (power-on defaults).
- Should not let guests overwrite admin/power-on defaults (that stays behind the 🔒).
close_reason: Implemented in Batch 2 commit a9d6204 (/admin page + guest tinker mode); firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash. (close was missed earlier.)

title: Decouple firmware param specs from deprecated TS generator
description:
cube_param_specs.h is GENERATED from src/shared/patterns/* by scripts/gen-param-specs.mts, which lives in the now-deprecated Node side (see project focus: firmware-only).

Decide: (a) keep TS as spec-only source and keep running the generator, or (b) make the C++ param specs authoritative and retire the generator. Blocks clean firmware-only workflow for new params/patterns. Low code, real decision.
close_reason: Resolved: cube_param_specs.h is now hand-maintained/authoritative; TS generator retired in-place; docs (AGENTS.md, firmware/README.md) + both source banners aligned. Comment/doc-only.

title: Preset import / export + naming (+ future AI naming) (firmware)
description:
Move presets in/out of the device as files.

- Export: download a preset (or the whole set) as the canonical JSON.
- Import: upload replaces/OVERWRITES existing preset(s) of the same name.
- Rename in UI. Delete (may share with CRUD issue).
- Future: AI-assisted naming. Default flow is manual: download -> AI edits file separately -> re-import.
close_reason: Implemented; firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Preset shuffle + 0-5 priority weighting (firmware)
description:
Shuffle mode with weighted priorities.

- Per-preset priority 1-5; weight the shuffle so higher ranks appear more often.
- Priority 0 = retained/saved but EXCLUDED from shuffle rotation.
- Toggle shuffle vs in-order cycling.
Depends on preset format (priority field) + playlist cycling.
close_reason: Implemented in commit; firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: ESP-NOW snake controller: cube-side receive + ESP32-C3 remote + 3D-printed case
description: Plan in docs/controller-plan.md. Cube side can land before hardware; controller env + case after flash day.

title: Audio-reactive wavy sheet variants
description: Wire band-split audio into wavySheet: bass drives base displacement, mids modulate amplitude, highs add small surface noise. Make the spike radial-from-center on transients.

title: Persisted presets / snapshots
description: Save/load named (patternId, params, layout) snapshots to disk on the server. Quick-launch from the UI.
close_reason: Superseded by the cube-eq5 preset/playlist epic (firmware): format+LittleFS CRUD, sidebar/playlist cycling, shuffle+priority, import/export — all implemented this session.

title: WLED handoff lifecycle (reclaim/release)
description: When server starts streaming, optionally pause WLED's own effects via JSON API. On stop, send a final 'release' packet and let WLED revert. Document the WLED 'live' indicator behavior we already see.

title: Pattern: rotating planes
description: A plane defined by normal n(t) and offset, lighting all voxels within thickness of the plane. Rotate over time. Bonus: stack multiple planes.

title: Pattern: rain / falling drops
description: Drops spawn on the top layer and fall along Z, leaving fading trails. Audio increases spawn rate.

title: Pattern: 3D plasma
description: Smooth volumetric noise field, hue-cycled. Good baseline for showing the 3D-ness of the cube.

title: Beat / onset detection
description: On top of audio bands: detect onsets (low-band energy ramp) and emit discrete beat events. Patterns can use these for explicit hits (e.g., wavySheet spike, flash plane).

title: Switch frame WS payload to binary
description: JSON of 3000 numbers per frame is wasteful. Send Uint8Array via ws binaryType='arraybuffer' on both sides. Should drop CPU/network considerably and let us push 60 fps.

title: On-chip JPEG decode for /api/image
description: Optional convenience: accept image/jpeg bodies on /api/image via JPEGDEC so HA automations can push entity_picture bytes without the ffmpeg shell_command hop. Watch the gledopto309 1.5MB app-slot ceiling (currently 87.3% full).

title: Image upload UI on the firmware console
description: POST /api/image exists (base64 RGB24 up to 64x64, box-downscaled to 10x10, LittleFS persistence, show=1). Add a small console affordance: file picker that draws to a canvas, downscales client-side, and posts — so album art / any image can be pushed from a phone without curl. Pattern: image-3d.

title: Optional: sparse 'embers' pattern to replace ditched fire
description: fire (Fire2012 volumetric) was removed in the overnight batch — it read as mush on the 10^3 cube and the user said it never worked. If a warm fire-ish look is missed: build a sparse ember pattern instead (black background, a few bright flickering embers rising from the base with audio fanning), which fits the cube's sparse/high-contrast strengths. rain + fire palette does not cover this (falls downward).

title: Audit all patterns for unscaled audio terms
description: wavy-sheet had a hardcoded 'beat * 2.0f * exp(-r*0.3)' bump that kept reacting to music with every audio slider at 0 (fixed in firmware-ux-batches). Sweep the other patterns' render() math for audio.level/beat/bands terms whose coefficient is a literal instead of a user-facing gain param, so zeroing the audio sliders truly silences reactivity everywhere.

title: Microphone squelch: explain mechanism + add slider
description:
The Microphone section only has a bare 'Squelch (raw RMS)' number box; the mechanism is opaque.

- Add a range SLIDER synced with the number input.
- Add explanatory text: soft-knee gate — fully gated below squelch/2, fully open at squelch (see audio_capture.cpp). Show live raw RMS (already in /api/audio) next to it so the user can pick a threshold by watching the number.
close_reason: Implemented in commit d852820; firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Spiral: cycling layer axis (switch X/Y/Z each pass)
description: pat_spiral.cpp axis is a fixed enum (z,y,x). Add an option where the layer axis CYCLES each time the spiral completes a full pass — e.g. an added 'cycle' enum value that advances X->Y->Z on each unwind, so orientation shifts over time.
close_reason: Implemented in commit d852820; firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Param modulation caps + audio-drive cap semantics + labels
description:
When speed/audio (mic) drives a param, cap how far it can push.

- Default cap: 2x the slider max (revisitable per-param).
- Make it discoverable: hover/text note on audio-driven params explaining the cap + that audio can exceed the slider.
Related to the LFO/modulation issue and param-section grouping.
notes: UI discoverability note (audio can exceed slider ~2x) done in d852820. Remaining: actual clamp enforcement at 2x slider max in pattern audio-drive code — deferred to the LFO/modulation batch (cube-la3).

title: Group params into Pattern / Audio / Color subsections in UI
description: In web_ui.h loadParams(), the param list renders flat. Group into clear subsections: pattern-specific, audio-specific (the *Gain/beat*/level* keys), and color (palette/r/g/b/sat). Makes audio-reactive knobs obvious; pairs with the audio-cap hover note.
close_reason: Implemented in commit d852820; firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash.

title: Move Admin controls off the main page to their own page/section
description: The Admin 🔒 dropdown (and likely Microphone) currently sits inline on the main page in web_ui.h. Move it to its own page or a distinct larger admin view so the main page stays focused on pattern + params + presets.
close_reason: Implemented in Batch 2 commit a9d6204 (/admin page + guest tinker mode); firmware builds clean. On-device verify pending flash. (close was missed earlier.)

title: Optional DDP backend
description: DDP supports >490 LEDs cleanly with a PUSH flag and is widely supported. Add DDP as an alternative to DNRGB for benchmarking and resilience.

title: Frame pacing and packet retransmission strategy
description: Today we just setInterval and fire 3 UDP packets per frame. Investigate sequencing/timing on a busy WiFi: do we drop frames? Should we retransmit? Use WLED 'UDP packet retransmissions' setting?

title: 3D mesh primitives library
description: Reusable helpers in shared/: implicit-surface marcher (sheet given f(x,y)->z), great-circle plane drawing, particle integrator with trail buffer, voxelized line/sphere drawers.

title: Pattern: 3D Conway-ish life
description: Pick a 3D life ruleset (e.g., 5766) that produces interesting steady-state activity. Render living cells with smooth alpha.

title: Pattern: fire / flame from base
description: Heat-diffusion model rising from z=0 with cooling and color ramp. 3D variant of the classic Fire2012.
